name: exposure_process_job
querySql: SELECT id, reticle_id AS key_reticle_id, rework_counter, CAST(CAST(reworked AS integer) AS boolean) AS reworked, CAST(jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot_id, 'equipmentId', machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'EXPOSURE') AS text) AS process_job_id, lot_id, key_lot_id, layer_id, key_layer_id AS key_physical_layer_id, product_id, machine_id AS equipment_id, lot_start AS start_time, lot_end AS end_time, recipe_name, software_release, CAST(CAST(latest_reworked AS integer) AS boolean) AS latest_reworked, CASE WHEN CAST(CAST(reworked AS integer) AS boolean) IS FALSE THEN CAST('NON_REWORKED' AS text) WHEN CAST(CAST(latest_reworked AS integer) AS boolean) IS TRUE THEN CAST('LATEST_REWORKED' AS text) ELSE CAST(NULL AS text) END AS rework_context, lis_instance_name FROM lisa.lot_exposure_step

name: job_has_input_exposure
querySql: SELECT job_id, lot_exposure_step_id FROM lisa.job_lot_exposure_step WHERE type IS NULL OR CAST(type AS text) <> CAST('OUTPUT' AS text)

name: latest_exposure
querySql: SELECT lot_exposure_step_id, lot_metrology_step_id FROM lisa.lot_kpi_mapping WHERE CAST(aggregation_level AS text) = CAST('LOT' AS text) AND lot_exposure_step_id IS NOT NULL AND lot_metrology_step_id IS NOT NULL

name: lis_job
querySql: SELECT id, instance_id, split_part(CAST(type AS text), CAST('/' AS text), 1) AS application_id, split_part(CAST(type AS text), CAST('/' AS text), 2) AS request_type, type, vcp_version, key_job_id AS compute_job_id, application, createdtime AS created_time, startedtime AS start_time, finishedtime AS end_time, status, software_release, CAST(NULL AS text) AS job_report_id, lis_instance_name, application_name, recipe_name, machine_id FROM lisa.job WHERE lower(CAST(application AS text)) = lower(CAST('Litho InSight' AS text))

name: measure_process_job
querySql: SELECT id, wafer_diameter, process_job_id AS input_lot_id, CAST(jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot_id, 'equipmentId', machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'MEASURE') AS text) AS process_job_id, lot_id, key_lot_id, layer_id, key_layer_id AS key_physical_layer_id, product_id, CAST(wafer_load_orientation AS integer) AS wafer_rotation, machine_id AS equipment_id, lot_start AS start_time, lot_end AS end_time, recipe_name, software_release, lis_instance_name FROM lisa.lot_metrology_step

name: vw_customer_name
querySql: SELECT exposure_machine.customername AS customer_name FROM lisa.exposure_machine UNION SELECT metrology_machine.customername AS customer_name FROM lisa.metrology_machine

name: vw_full_triplet
querySql: SELECT lec.lot_exposure_step_id, lec.lot_metrology_step_id, l2e.job_id FROM lisa.latest_exposure AS lec, lisa.job_has_input_exposure AS l2e, lisa.job_has_input_measure AS l2m WHERE lec.lot_metrology_step_id = l2m.lot_metrology_step_id AND l2m.job_id = l2e.job_id AND l2e.lot_exposure_step_id = lec.lot_exposure_step_id

name: vw_layer_id
querySql: SELECT DISTINCT key_layer_id FROM lisa.lot_step ORDER BY key_layer_id

name: vw_product_id
querySql: SELECT lot_metrology_step.product_id FROM lisa.lot_metrology_step UNION SELECT lot_exposure_step.product_id FROM lisa.lot_exposure_step ORDER BY 1

name: wafer_exposure_process_job
querySql: SELECT wafer.id, wafer.wafer_id, wafer.wafer_sequencenr AS wafer_processing_order, wafer.wafer_start AS start_time, wafer.wafer_end AS end_time, wafer.wafer_result AS status, wafer.wafer_sequencenr AS wafer_sequence_number, wafer.chuck_id, wafer.key_wafer_id, wafer.rework_counter, CAST(CAST(wafer.reworked AS integer) AS boolean) AS reworked, CAST(jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot.lot_id, 'equipmentId', lot.machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot.lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'EXPOSURE') AS text) AS process_job_id, CAST(jsonb_build_object('processJobId', jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot.lot_id, 'equipmentId', lot.machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot.lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'EXPOSURE'), 'waferId', wafer.wafer_id, 'waferProcessingOrder', wafer.wafer_sequencenr) AS text) AS wafer_process_job_id, lot.id AS lot_exposure_step_id FROM lisa.wafer_exposure_step AS wafer LEFT JOIN lisa.lot_exposure_step AS lot ON wafer.lot_exposure_step_id = lot.id

name: wafer_latest_exposure
querySql: SELECT wafer_exposure_step_id, wafer_metrology_step_id FROM lisa.wafer_kpi_mapping WHERE wafer_exposure_step_id IS NOT NULL AND wafer_metrology_step_id IS NOT NULL

name: wafer_measure_process_job
querySql: SELECT wafer.id, wafer.wafer_id, wafer.wafer_sequencenr AS wafer_processing_order, wafer.measurement_start_time AS start_time, wafer.status, wafer.key_wafer_id, CAST(jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot.lot_id, 'equipmentId', lot.machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot.lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'MEASURE') AS text) AS process_job_id, CAST(jsonb_build_object('processJobId', jsonb_build_object('lotId', lot.lot_id, 'equipmentId', lot.machine_id, 'lotStart', replace(to_char(pg_catalog.timezone(CAST('UTC' AS text), lot.lot_start), CAST('YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"' AS text)), CAST('.000Z' AS text), CAST('Z' AS text)), 'processJobType', 'MEASURE'), 'waferId', wafer.wafer_id, 'waferProcessingOrder', wafer.wafer_sequencenr) AS text) AS wafer_process_job_id, lot.id AS lot_metrology_step_id FROM lisa.wafer_metrology_step AS wafer LEFT JOIN lisa.lot_metrology_step AS lot ON wafer.lot_metrology_step_id = lot.id
